functionalReqs: Chat about the codebase with references to files
Agent mode: plan, edit multiple files, run tests
Respect enterprise privacy (no training on customer code unless allowed)
hints: Completion and agent tasks have very different latency and model-size needs. Use one model or two?
What context goes into a completion prompt? The current file isn't enough.

Completions: small fast model (fill-in-the-middle), client-side debouncing and cancellation, context from cursor prefix/suffix, open tabs and retrieved snippets, regional GPU serving, caching. Chat/agent: large model with tool calling (search code, read file, edit, run tests) over a repo index (embeddings + symbol graph), sandboxed execution, diffs shown for approval. Evaluate with acceptance rate, retained code, and benchmark suites (unit-test pass rate).
nonFunctionalReqs: Inline completions in under 300 ms end to end
Agent actions are safe and reviewable
problemStatement: Design an **AI coding assistant** for an IDE with two features: inline code completion as the developer types, and a chat/agent that can read the repository and propose multi-file edits.
title: Design an AI Coding Assistant
